question.text: A crystalline solid of a pure substance has a face-centred cubic structure with a cell edge of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>400</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi>pm</mi></math> . If the density of the substance in the crystal is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mi>cm</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi></math> then the number of atoms present in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>256</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of the crystal <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>is</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>×</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>24</mn></msup></math> . The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mo> </mo></math>is

solution.text:

For FCC unit cell Z,=4
